# Question 1

## Q1a

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)

filename <- "EgyptData.xlsx"

sheet_names <- excel_sheets(filename)
sheet_names

mineral_measures <- read_excel(
  filename,
  sheet = "mineral_measures"
)

materials <- read_excel(
  filename,
  sheet = "materials"
)
```

## Q1b

We can say that `sample_id` and `material_id` correspond to the same specimen, so the two tables can be joined. This is reasonable because both `materials` and `mineral_measures` have 75 rows, with the IDs going from 1 to 75 in the same order. Both datasets are in wide format because each specimen has its own row and its different details or measurements are stored in separate columns. The observational unit in both datasets is one specimen, while `sample_id` and `material_id` are used to identify each specimen.

## Q1c

```{r}
hyksos <- full_join(
  materials,
  mineral_measures,
  by = c("material_id" = "sample_id")
)
```

## Q1d

```{r}
df <- hyksos %>%
  select(
    relative_dating_upper_limit,
    biological_sex,
    sr87_sr86
  ) %>%
  rename(
    dates = relative_dating_upper_limit,
    sex = biological_sex,
    sr = sr87_sr86
  )
```

## Q1e

```{r}
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    sex = gsub(
      'F\\?',
      'F',
      gsub('M\\?', 'M', sex)
    )
  )
```

# Question 2

## Q2a

```{r}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    period = ifelse(
      dates >= -1991 & dates <= -1649,
      "Pre-Hyksos",
      "Hyksos"
    )
  )
```

## Q2b

```{r}
sex_summary <- df %>% 
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(sr),
    SD = sd(sr),
    Count = n()
  )

print(sex_summary)
```

## Q2c

```{r}
period_summary <- df %>% 
  filter(!is.na(period)) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(sr),
    SD = sd(sr),
    Count = n()
  )

print(period_summary)
```

## Q2d

```{r}
df %>% 
  arrange(sr) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = rank, y = sr)) +
  geom_point()
```

## Q2e

```{r}
df %>% 
  filter(!is.na(sex)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sex, y = sr)) +

  )
```

# Question 3

## Q3a

```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

f1_circuits <- read.csv(
  "f1_circuits.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

f1_drivers <- read.csv(
  "f1_drivers.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

f1_races <- read.csv(
  "f1_races.csv",
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)

f1_conn <- dbConnect(
  RSQLite::SQLite(),
  "f1.sqlite"
)

dbWriteTable(
  f1_conn,
  "f1_circuits",
  f1_circuits,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

dbWriteTable(
  f1_conn,
  "f1_drivers",
  f1_drivers,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

dbWriteTable(
  f1_conn,
  "f1_races",
  f1_races,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

dbListTables(f1_conn)
```

## Q3b

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  f1_conn,
  "
  SELECT forename, surname
  FROM f1_drivers
  WHERE nationality = 'Czech'
  "
)
```

## Q3c

```{r}
drivers1 <- dbGetQuery(
  f1_conn,
  "
  SELECT *
  FROM f1_drivers
  WHERE surname = 'Rosberg'
  AND nationality = 'Finnish'
  OR forename = 'Robert'
  AND code LIKE 'K%'
  "
)

drivers1
```

## Q3d

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  f1_conn,
  "
  SELECT name, country
  FROM f1_circuits
  ORDER BY ABS(latitude)
  LIMIT 1
  "
)
```

## Q3e

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  f1_conn,
  "
  SELECT f1_circuits.country
  FROM f1_races 
  INNER JOIN f1_circuits
  ON f1_races.circuitId = f1_circuits.circuitId
  WHERE f1_races.year = 2001
  AND f1_races.name = 'European Grand Prix'
  "
)
```

## Q3f

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  f1_conn,
  "
  SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS number_of_races
  FROM f1_races 
  LEFT JOIN f1_circuits
  ON f1_races.circuitId = f1_circuits.circuitId 
  WHERE year >= 2000
  GROUP BY country
  HAVING number_of_races >= 24 
  ORDER BY number_of_races DESC
  "
)
```

## Q3g

```{r}
dbGetQuery(
  f1_conn,
  "
  SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS number_of_circuits
  FROM f1_circuits
  GROUP BY country
  ORDER BY number_of_circuits DESC
  LIMIT 1
  "
)
```

## Q3h

When `dbRollback()` is run, the database returns to auto-commit mode, and any changes made since `dbBegin()` are undone and not saved.

## Q3i

```{r}
dbDisconnect(f1_conn)
```
